api.notes: `error`, `warning`, `success` and, beyond upstream, `info` (the Tecton status set).
Plain text; the default slot takes richer content.

api.reason: `id` is a global attribute (A§7.1). tct-field and tct-text-input give the status satellite it creates a generated id, or the `status-id` you set.

hooks.notes: @tecton-astryx/core/a11y/announcer.js: an error is announced assertively, every other type politely; skipped for the satellite a field or text input owns, which announces itself once.
A fade from the shared motion module; no movement, so there is nothing to switch off under reduced motion.

differences.text: A status is coloured ink on the page with no message box behind it (tecton-astryx components.ts `field-status`, textfield.md); the `detached` variant adds the leading icon and the gap above it, the `attached` variant keeps the text directly under the control.
`type` also accepts `info`, which the Tecton status set has and the upstream TextInput tooltip variant already needs.
A standalone error is announced assertively where the field chrome announces it politely once when it appears; both never fire together because an owned satellite does not announce on its own.

core.field-status.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-error-announcement] polite/assertive live announcements through the shared announcer; [mwg:accessible-web-components] the status is referenced from the control with aria-describedby.
